observations: body L1, L2, L5, L10, L23, L26: «Friedlaen-», «der» (L1-L2) and «Friedlaender» (L23) are letter-spaced, «Friedl.» (L5) and «Friedlaender» (L26) are not; «Ibn al-Haytham» is letter-spaced in L5, not in L10.

body L2, L3, L22: the dot over the first letter of «ضفي» is printed small (0.8 by 0.7 points; the dots of ḍād in «مضى» and «بعض», L22, measure 1.3-1.7 points). Transcribed as printed; the rendering «cui hoc argumentum sit clarum» (L3) requires «صفي».
body L2, L7, L20, L21: «الا» (L2, L7) is printed with the crossed sort of lām-alif that stands in «الاول» (L20) and «الاخبار» (L21), 7.4-7.8 points wide; the lām-alif of «لا» (L2) is 4.6 points wide.
body L12: a speck (0.8 by 0.6 points) is printed between «יכונו» and «מאמר»; not transcribed.
body L12, L15: the first letter of «גם» (L15) is a gimel, its foot turned to the left, not the nun of «נכבד» (L12).

body L24: «الמִצְווֹת» is printed with the Arabic article ال joined to the Hebrew word (the lām touches the mem). The Hebrew is pointed: a ḥiriq under the mem, a shva under the tsadi (its two dots run together into one stroke, 2.4 points long) and a ḥolam merged with the head of the second waw.
body L27, L28: the kasra under the r of «الرِّشَاء» (L27) is printed low, just above L28; the f of «cfr.» is printed blotted, and a dot stands in the margin after it; not transcribed.
body L28: «aṣ-Ṣūfī» is printed with a hyphen (3.8 points), not with the en dash of p. 329.
body L29: the dash of «81–82» runs 4.3 points up to the 8, which it touches; the hyphens of this page measure 2.9-3.8 points.
body L32, L34: «[رَصْدٌ]» (L32) has a sukūn on the ṣād, «رَصَدٌ» (L34) a fatḥa.
body L33: the last digit of «١٩٢» is 2.9 points wide, as the 2 of «٢٠٩»; a 3 measures 4.7-4.8 points on this page. The 2 and the 9 of «١٢٩» touch (5.6 points), as on p. 330.
